title: Hebrews Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Hebrews 11: faith as assurance of things hoped for, from Abel and Noah to Moses, Jericho and Rahab.

questions.explanation: Verse 1 says faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

answers.text: A promise given to the elders of Israel
The keeping of the whole law of Moses
Assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen
A sacrifice offered for things not seen

questions.text: Whose sacrifice is called more excellent than Cain's?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says that by faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain.

answers.text: Abel's
Noah's
Enoch's
Abraham's

questions.text: What happened to Enoch by faith?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says that by faith Enoch was taken away so that he would not see death, and he was not found, because God translated him.

answers.text: He prepared a ship for his house
He was hidden for three months
He passed through the Red Sea
He was taken away so that he would not see death

questions.text: What did Noah prepare, being warned about things not yet seen?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says that by faith Noah, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house.

answers.text: An altar on a mountain
A ship for the saving of his house
A tent in the land of promise
A city with foundations

questions.text: What did Abraham do when he was called?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says that by faith Abraham obeyed and went out to the place he was to receive for an inheritance, not knowing where he went.

answers.text: He stayed in his father's house
He built a city with foundations
He went out, not knowing where he went
He asked for a sign from heaven

questions.text: What did Sarah receive by faith, according to verse 11?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says that by faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age.

answers.text: Power to conceive
A land of her own
A new name
A better resurrection

questions.text: How long was Moses hidden by his parents when he was born?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says that by faith Moses was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child.

answers.text: Seven days
Three months
Forty days
One whole year

questions.text: What did Moses refuse when he had grown up?
questions.explanation: Verse 24 says that by faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter.

answers.text: To share ill treatment with God's people
To keep the Passover and sprinkle the blood
To go up and speak before the king of Egypt
To be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter

questions.text: What fell down by faith, after being encircled for seven days?
questions.explanation: Verse 30 says that by faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been encircled for seven days.

answers.text: The walls of Jericho
The gates of Egypt
The towers of Salem
The house of Rahab

questions.text: What did Rahab the prostitute do, according to verse 31?
questions.explanation: Verse 31 says that by faith Rahab the prostitute did not perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

answers.text: She hid inside the walls of the city
She sent her sons into Jericho
She received the spies in peace
She offered a sacrifice for the city
